title: Switches in admin draw the kit switch instead of an empty button, and the admin forms stop hand-building their own

source.ref: LIVE-938 area 4 (admin widgets) and the members-ui.css bridge cleanup

detail: The shared Switch renders the kit's .sw under Frequency, but only the members kit styled .sw. Inside [data-kit="admin"] every shared Switch (the admin Toggle used by the AI, payments and demo settings, the page-layout render toggle, Space module switches) drew as an empty, unstyled button. admin-pages.css now styles .sw the way the admin templates do (they load the members app.css). Seven admin forms (menu on/off, connection settings, scan-intro emails, crew tasks, walkthrough row and editor, elements) drew their own role="switch" with bg-primary, which only read right because members-ui.css repainted it. They now use the shared Switch.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];if(!fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/admin-pages.css','utf8').includes('[data-kit=\"admin\"] .sw{'))bad.push('admin kit has no switch style');for(const p of ['components/admin/menu/on-off-toggle.tsx','components/admin/connection-settings-admin.tsx','app/(main)/admin/crm/contacts/scan-invite-toggle.tsx','app/(main)/admin/crew-tasks/crew-tasks-client.tsx','app/(main)/admin/walkthroughs/row-actions.tsx','app/(main)/admin/walkthroughs/[id]/editor.tsx','app/(main)/admin/elements/elements-editor.tsx']){const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(s.includes('role=\"switch\"')||!s.includes('<Switch '))bad.push(p)}if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1102: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the admin kit loses its switch style or an admin form hand-builds a switch again. Behavior is admin-switches.test.ts.
